posts: Reviewed three tx previews this morning and every single one showed me a hex blob. If your wallet can't explain a transaction in plain English, it's a liability, not a product. #wallets #near

Chain signatures should kill the connect-wallet modal, not multiply it. One NEAR account signing across every chain is the whole pitch — now ship the SDK ergonomics so devs actually use it. #chainsignatures #near

replies.text: Chain abstraction is only real when the wallet disappears into the app. Chain signatures get us there; the remaining work is UX, not consensus.
On-chain alpha is worthless if wallets only render raw hex. Fix the human-readable tx layer and everyone can verify claims themselves.
